note: Institutional counterparties. Lets a fingerprint hit or an attributed artwork resolve straight to a posture and a licensing route.

holders.note: Composition rights; separate from Warner Music Group's master rights.

holders.name: Kobalt Music Group

holders.name: Universal Music Group
holders.note: Master-use side. A sync licence from the publisher does NOT cover the recording.

holders.name: Getty Images

holders.name: Shutterstock

holders.name: Associated Press
